readings: as v0 (reader_bottleneck if privileged Q1 acc < .65; no_headroom; headroom_present; full_prefix_wins). If v0.1 also lands in reader_bottleneck: the SN7 4 m quadrant questions are re-designed before any human labelling; Chuseok labelling is postponed.
not_allowed: changing items/conditions/questions/K; comparing v0 and v0.1 readers as a reader benchmark (this is a diagnostic of evidence selection, the reader is instrumentation)
